tools.name: search_used_cars
tools.description: Search used cars for sale in India. All filters optional. Returns total count, listings (title, price in INR, year, kms, fuel, transmission, city, image, url) and a search_page_url with the full results.

tools.name: find_city
tools.description: Look up Indian cities, localities or states by partial or misspelt name. Ranked best first (exact, starts-with, contains, typo; then by number of listings). Pass a returned slug as `city` to search_used_cars.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full details for one listing by id (from search_used_cars), including the seller description.
